meta.title: Star Fox – Nintendo Switch 2 Exclusive - Nintendo Official Site for Canada
meta.description: Join Fox McCloud in Star Fox, a Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive. A cinematic reimagining of Star Fox 64 with orchestral music and enhanced visuals.

asset.alt: Fox McCloud steers the Arwing while blasting out two green lasers. The Arwing gently floats and moves, mimicking its journey through space.

modules.heading: Save the Lylat System with Fox McCloud!

content.value: Join Fox McCloud and the Star Fox team as you fight to protect the Lylat System from the clutches of the evil scientist Dr. Andross! Take to the skies—and stars—as you blast your way through enemies in this action-packed adventure.

asset.alt: Fox McCloud steers the Arwing while blasting out two green lasers. The Arwing gently floats and moves, mimicking its journey through space.

modules.heading: Save the Lylat System with Fox McCloud!

content.value: Join Fox McCloud and the Star Fox team as you fight to protect the Lylat System from the clutches of the evil scientist Dr. Andross! Take to the skies—and stars—as you blast your way through enemies in this action-packed adventure.
This cinematic take on the Star Fox 64 story features new fully voiced dialogue, an epic orchestral soundtrack, and a complete visual overhaul for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system.

modules.heading: Lock in for a high-octane adventure

content.value: Take off on a fast-paced campaign that will have you tearing through space, soaring across planets, and shooting loads of foes out of the sky at every turn.

modules.alt: The Arwing and a rival ship are caught mid battle. The rival ship blasts golden lasers at the Arwing as it attempts to fly by.

asset.alt: As seen on a computer screen, the Arwing is spotted flying through clouds and above an ocean.

content.value: Nimble and reliable, this all-range fighter is the main vehicle of the Star Fox team. Go head-to-head with Dr. Andross’s ruthless forces in planet-spanning missions that’ll put your flight-combat skills to the test.

asset.alt: Gameplay of the Arwing flying as the character Peppy instructs the player to do a barrel roll.

content.value: Maneuver your vehicles to quickly dodge enemy fire. Deploy boosts for added thrust. Lock onto targets, then eliminate them using homing lasers and powerful bomb attacks.

asset.alt: In the driver's seat of the Arwing, the player aims a laser at a rival ship, blasting it down above the ocean.

content.value: Play in classic third-person perspective or enter first-person mode to experience the action from inside the cockpit. You can even take on missions using the mouse controls on your Joy-Con™ 2 controllers.

asset.alt: A split screen of two battle modes, Easy and Normal. The Easy screen shows the player aiming towards a rival ship, while the Normal screen shows the player lowering its aim after defeating a rival.

modules.heading: Decide how fierce your battle will be

content.value: Play the campaign on Normal difficulty. Earn every medal to unlock Expert. Or choose Easy for a sturdier ship and more powerful laser.

modules.heading: Discover every part of the story

content.value: Sharpen your skills when you replay missions and aim for higher scores. Completing certain objectives can unlock a different path, dramatically changing which missions become available.
Embark on missions taking you from the stars to deep underwater, and more! Explore some of the locations you’ll traverse during your campaign.
Home to Corneria Defense Force Headquarters, and the center of politics, economy, and culture in the Lylat System.
Known widely as “the ice planet,” snow and ice cover nearly 90% of Fichina’s surface.
The Lylat System’s second, smaller star known for its extreme temperatures and thermonuclear qualities.
Known previously as a popular vacation destination, heavy resource mining has since turned the once-beautiful paradise planet into a heavily polluted zone.
An asteroid field known for mining operations. Recent surveillance has detected unusual energy readings from within…
Named for its Y-shaped form, it is one of three unique space-dust formations within the Lylat System.

asset.alt: The underside of the Arwing with the engines blasting as it flies through space.

content.value: Replay missions in Challenge Mode to clear objectives that unlock in-game rewards like Holoviewer logs that give you special intel on characters and mission locations.
Get primed on key Star Fox members and their main adversary.

asset.alt: A holographic Fox McCloud pulsates up and down.

content.value: A promising young pilot and charismatic leader of the elite mercenary team known as Star Fox. Brash and self-assured, Fox follows in the footsteps of his father, James, who founded the original Star Fox team.

modules.alt: Fox McCloud stands infront of his ship's control system. Holographic planets and characters rise from it as he speaks to them.
modules.caption: Fox McCloud stands infront of his ship's control system. Holographic planets and characters rise from it as he speaks to them.

asset.alt: A holographic Falco Lombardi pulsates gently up and down.

content.value: The latest addition to the Star Fox team. Despite having no formal flight training, Falco has proven himself an extremely capable combat pilot while sharing a friendly rivalry with Fox.

modules.alt: Aboard the Arwing, Falco animatedly talks to Fox McCloud, and Peppy.
modules.caption: Aboard the Arwing, Falco animatedly talks to Fox McCloud, and Peppy.

asset.alt: A holographic Slippy Toad pulsates up and down as they point towards something in the distance.

content.value: A talented flight engineer and technician, Slippy has become an invaluable asset to the Star Fox crew. Optimistic but at times naïve, his unapologetic positivity provides much-needed camaraderie for the team.

modules.alt: Slippy Toad sits inside the Arwing and switches between looking at a holographic deck of some planets and looking directly out towards the viewer.
modules.caption: Slippy Toad sits inside the Arwing and switches between looking at a holographic deck of some planets and looking directly out towards the viewer.

asset.alt: A holographic Peppy Hare pulsates gently up and down.

content.value: A veteran combat pilot known for his sharp tactical analysis, Peppy co-founded Star Fox with his good friend James McCloud. Meticulous, steadfast, and fiercely loyal, he is something of a father figure to the current Star Fox team, especially to its current leader (and James’s son), Fox.

modules.alt: Peppy Hare and Fox McCloud talk over a holographic image before the video cuts to showing Peppy Hare in the pilot's seat.
modules.caption: Peppy Hare and Fox McCloud talk over a holographic image before the video cuts to showing Peppy Hare in the pilot's seat.

asset.alt: The head and hands of Andross float menacingly.

content.value: Once widely regarded as a brilliant scientist in the Corneria Defense Force, Dr. Andross has now proclaimed himself emperor of the Lylat System. His treasonous actions exiled him to the remote planet Venom, where he now commands his forces in a ruthless mission to conquer the universe.

modules.alt: As the Arwing floats and dodges attacks, on screen text of Andross appears, taunting the player.
modules.caption: As the Arwing floats and dodges attacks, on screen text of Andross appears, taunting the player.

content.value: Vie for dominance over the stars with—or against—your friends* in Battle Mode.

asset.alt: From the POV of the player at home, we see online friend's ships fly ahead.

content.value: Engage in intense, four-on-four team-based battles online* with friends or players from around the world. You’ll play across three stages including Corneria, Sector Y, and Fichina—each with different rules and objectives.
All six stages are now available in a free update. Internet connection and software update required to download.

asset.alt: The Nintendo Switch 2 system houses gamplay footage as it showcases the Gameshare capability to other Nintendo Switch systems.

content.value: Play with friends on the same system, online, or via local GameShare**! Invite a friend along for the entire story campaign in co-op mode, or even battle with (or against) up to three friends in local split screen.
Local Split-Screen Battle Mode is available in a free update. Internet connection and software update required to download.

modules.heading: Become a member of Star Fox

content.value: Connect a compatible USB camera, like the Nintendo Switch 2 camera (sold separately), to play face-to-face with friends over GameChat***. Use Character Avatars to appear as your favorite characters or use AR filters to layer Fox-like ears, sunglasses, helmets, and other accessories over your in-game image!
Video features require a compatible USB camera accessory (sold separately).

asset.alt: A group shot of Fox, Falco and Wolf's Amiibo surrounded by a rotating orange circle.

content.value: Tap the amiibo™ figures for Fox, Falco, or Wolf to get additional backgrounds and emblems for your multiplayer Battle Banner.
Figures shown not actual size. amiibo sold separately. Visit
amiibo.com
for details on amiibo functionality.

asset.alt: A heightened moment of battle showcasing the Arwing surrounded by explosion and attacking enemies alludes to what fans can expect in the Game Demo.

content.value: Experience the full tutorial and the Meteo campaign stage!

modules.alt: A driverless Arwing ship rocks back and forth over the Game Demo.
The Nintendo Switch 2 system houses a cinematic moment of gameplay as the Arwing rests just above water level.
Surrounded by a chaotic landscape, Fox McCloud cooly leans against the wing of the Arwing while holding a drink.

Product:{\"sku\":\"7100123167\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Step into the cockpit and fly across the stars and skies with Fox McCloud and team! The Lylat system is under attack, and it’s up to the Star Fox™ squad to blast their way through this enemy invasion in a fast-paced adventure that will have you tearing through space, soaring across planets, and shooting loads of foes out of the sky at every step of the way.

This cinematic take on the Star Fox 64 story features fully voiced dialogue and cutscenes, an epic orchestral soundtrack, mouse control support, and a complete visual overhaul that takes advantage of the enhanced performance of the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system.

Try the campaign on Easy to play with a sturdier ship and more powerful weapons, or unlock Expert difficulty for an additional challenge. You can also invite a friend to join you as a gunner in two-player co-op*—experience the entire story campaign together locally or online** through GameShare*** via GameChat****!

Sharpen your skills to complete objectives, unlock additional routes through the story, and aim for a high score

Pay careful attention to your squadmates during missions—follow their cues and you can unlock different routes through each area. Not only that, but completing certain objectives can also dramatically change what your next mission briefing looks like and what missions become available.

Replay individual missions in Challenge Mode to clear specific objectives that will unlock in-game rewards like Holoviewer logs to learn about people and places.

Vie for dominance over the stars in online battles with up to eight total players

Hop online** to take part in four-on-four team-based battles with a variety of objectives, whether with friends or with players from near and far. Use a Character Avatar to become a Star Fox character over GameChat****, and your friends will see the character animate according to your movements. You can also use AR filters to make it look like you’ve got Fox-like ears, sunglasses, and more!

And if you’re playing with friends, only one of you needs to have the game—up to four players can play Battle Mode together with GameShare*** via GameChat. You can also use GameShare via local wireless to play with friends who have Nintendo Switch 2 or Nintendo Switch systems!

Download a free update to play Battle Mode locally with four players in three more stages

Join the fray with a total of four players in local split-screen Battle Mode*****. Three stages have also been added. Control the platform to activate a devastating laser on Katina, destroy asteroids while evading destructive waves of energy in Sector X, and scan the data module and then evacuate while evading the defense system on Venom.

You and your friends playing in local split-screen can also join online** battles as a group.

Tap any existing amiibo****** figures of Star Fox characters for in-game extras

Get in-game extras, like additional backgrounds and emblems for your multiplayer Battle Banner, by tapping the Fox, Falco, or Wolf amiibo™ figures.
